name: portfolio
description: Static portfolio site. Node is only used for asset/build tooling, the site itself ships as plain HTML/CSS/JS.

scripts.build:js: terser app.dev.js -c -m -o app.js && terser canvas-ui.dev.js -c -m -o canvas-ui.js && terser hero-bubble.dev.js -c -m -o hero-bubble.js
scripts.build: npm run images && npm run pictures && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
